subject: general
question: Biological disasters are mainly caused by ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**infectious diseases and epidemics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Biological disasters occur due to the spread of **infectious diseases and epidemics**, which are caused by microorganisms like bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites.
 
• Examples of biological disasters include the outbreak of pandemics like **COVID-19, Ebola, SARS, and influenza**.
 
• Such disasters result in large-scale illness or death and often require extensive public health interventions to control their spread.
 
• Factors like globalization, urbanization, and ecological disruptions contribute to the **increased frequency and intensity** of biological disasters.
 
• Organizations like the **World Health Organization (WHO)** and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) work globally to monitor, control, and mitigate the impact of these disasters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Climate Change:**

 
 
• Climate change refers to long-term changes in global or regional climate patterns, often attributed to human activities such as deforestation and burning fossil fuels.
 
 
 
• **Fire and Smoke:**
 
 
• Fire and smoke disasters, such as forest fires and industrial fires, are categorized as environmental or man-made disasters rather than biological disasters.
 
• These events primarily result in respiratory health issues and environmental damage, rather than being caused by infectious agents.
 
 
 
• **Earthquakes and Volcanic Eruptions:**
 
 
• Earthquakes and volcanic eruptions are geological disasters caused by tectonic activity within the Earth’s crust.
